### Read in Data File

```{r}
library(readr)

nfl_data <- readRDS("data/nfl_clean.rds")

head(nfl_data)
```

### EDA

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
#Since the goal is to predict the number of air yards lets do some EDA to fix na values
nfl_data <- nfl_data |> mutate(air_yards = replace_na(air_yards,0))

head(nfl_data)
```

### Split the Data for Test and Train

```{r}

library(tidymodels)

set.seed(1)

nfl_split <- initial_split(nfl_data, prop = 0.7)

nfl_train <- training(nfl_split)

nfl_test <- testing(nfl_split)

dim(nfl_train)
dim(nfl_test)

```

### 5 Fold CV

```{r}

nfl_data_5_fold <- vfold_cv(nfl_data, 5)

nfl_data_5_fold
```

### Create the Models

#### Regression Tree

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(rpart.plot)

recipe_1 <- recipe(air_yards ~ qb_dropback + shotgun + posteam + yardline_100, data = nfl_data) |> step_rm(all_numeric_predictors())

recipe_1

tune_spec <- decision_tree(
  cost_complexity = tune(),
  tree_depth = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("rpart") |>
  set_mode("regression")

tree_grid <- grid_regular(cost_complexity(),
                          tree_depth(),
                          levels =5)
tree_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(recipe_1) |>
  add_model(tune_spec)

tree_res <- tree_wf |> tune_grid(resamples = nfl_data_5_fold, grid = tree_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

best_tree <- select_best(tree_res, metric = "rmse")
tree_final_wf <- finalize_workflow(tree_wf, best_tree)
final_tree <- fit(tree_final_wf, nfl_train)



```

#### Random Forest

```{r}
library(ranger)
library(vip)
rf_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(), min_n = tune(), trees = 500) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity") |>
  set_mode("regression")

rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_model(rf_spec) |>
  add_recipe(recipe_1)

# grid for all features
rf_grid <- grid_regular(mtry(range = c(1,3)), min_n(), levels = 5)
rf_res <-rf_wf |>
  tune_grid(resamples = nfl_data_5_fold, grid = rf_grid, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

best_rf <- select_best(rf_res, metric = "rmse")
rf_final_wf <- finalize_workflow(rf_wf, best_rf)
final_rf <- fit(rf_final_wf, nfl_train)
```
